newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex says to open new refinery plant on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Pemex says to open new refinery plant on Monday.

text.p: Mexico's state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) plans to open a new hydroresidual desulphurizing plant at its refinery in Tula, Hidalgo state, a Pemex spokeswoman said on Friday.
Tula was Mexico's second largest refinery as of 1995, with average production of 278,900 barrels per day.
Pemex director general Adrian Lajous has said the new refining unit at Tula will help process heavy crude and fuel oil to reduce the country's gasoline imports.
The cost of the new unit will be about $600 million, he said.

Mexico is tendering an approximately $1.2 billion construction project at the northern Cadereyta refinery that is also expected to boost gasoline production and process heavy crude. Bids for the project are due in August.
